blocks.text: Mechanism woh raasta (pathway) hai jis par reaction chalta hai; yeh dikhata hai ke product banne tak substrate mein kaun se bonds toot'te aur kaun se bante hain. Reagents ki qism ke lihaz se mechanisms ki do bari qismein hain:
1) Free Radical Mechanism
Is mein homolysis hota hai, jis se free radicals bante hain jo substrate molecule par hamla (attack) karte hain. Maslan:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke free radicals substrate se “attach” hote hain; sahi lafz “attack” (hamla karna) hai.

Yeh reaction free radical mechanism se hota hai jo Chemistry 11 mein parha ja chuka hai. Pehle initiation hota hai jis mein shuru ke free radicals bante hain. Phir propagation (phailao) ke qadam mein yeh radicals mazeed radicals banate hain. Aakhir mein termination hota hai: aik jaise ya mukhtalif free radicals aapas mein jur jate hain aur reaction ruk jata hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Light Cl₂ ko do Cl• mein torti hai (initiation). Cl• + CH₄ → HCl + •CH₃, phir •CH₃ + Cl₂ → CH₃Cl + Cl• (propagation: har qadam naya radical deta hai). Do radicals mil jayein, maslan Cl• + Cl• → Cl₂, to chain reaction khatam (termination). Cl₂ zyada ho to yeh chalta rehta hai aur aakhir mein CCl₄ tak pohanchta hai.
2) Ionic ya polar mechanism
Is mein heterolysis hota hai, jis se electrophiles aur nucleophiles bante hain jo polar substrate molecules par hamla karte hain. Polar mechanism ki yeh qismein hain:
i) Nucleophilic Substitution Reactions
Is reaction mein nucleophile aik saturated electrophilic carbon par hamla karta hai aur doosre nucleophile ki jagah le leta hai; nikalne wale group ko leaving group kehte hain. Maslan:

blocks.alt: H-O- (nucleophile, lone pair ke saath) bromomethane ke carbon par hamla karta hai (aik H dashed bond par, aik wedge par, aik seedhi lakeer par; C +delta, Br -delta); aik mura teer O se C ki taraf aur doosra C-Br bond se Br ki taraf. Is se brackets mein transition state banti hai, charge (-): HO, C aur Br dashed lakeeron se jure, C par teen H. Phir methanol, H-O-C teen H ke saath, aur Br- (leaving group) bante hain.
blocks.caption: Nucleophilic substitution: hydroxide ion aur bromomethane se transition state ke zariye methanol (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: OH⁻ (nucleophile) apna electron jora carbon par us taraf se lata hai jo Br ke bilkul ulat hai. Transition state mein O aur Br dono C se aadhe jure hote hain (dashed lakeerein) aur negative charge (−) dono par phaila hota hai. Aakhir mein Br apne bond ka jora le kar Br⁻ ki shakal mein nikal jata hai (leaving group) aur methanol banta hai.
ii) Nucleophilic Addition Reactions
Is reaction mein nucleophile carbonyl compound (C=O wale compound) ke electrophilic carbon par hamla karta hai aur addition product banta hai. Maslan:

blocks.alt: Lone pair wala N teen-bond C- ethanal ke +delta carbon par hamla karta hai (C=O, O par -delta, carbon par H3C aur H); aik mura teer lone pair se C ki taraf aur doosra C=O bond se O ki taraf. Is se N-C-C(H)(CH3) banta hai jis ke O- par lone pairs hain. H-CN (+delta H, -delta CN) ke saath yeh 2-hydroxy propanenitrile, N-C-C(OH)(CH3)-H, aur CN- deta hai.
blocks.caption: Nucleophilic addition: cyanide ion ethanal se jur kar 2-hydroxypropanenitrile banata hai (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: CN⁻ ka lone pair ethanal ke +δ carbon par jata hai, aur C=O ka π jora O par chala jata hai; is tarah O⁻ wala anion banta hai. Yeh anion HCN se H⁺ le leta hai: OH group ban jata hai aur CN⁻ wapas mil jata hai, jo phir agle molecule par hamla kar sakta hai.
iii) Electrophilic Addition Reactions
Is reaction mein electrophile kisi aisi jagah par hamla karta hai jahan electrons zyada hon (nucleophilic jagah), jaise carbon-carbon double ya triple bond. Maslan:

blocks.alt: H2C=CH2 (ethene) aur H-Br, H par +delta aur Br par -delta; aik mura teer C=C double bond se H ki taraf. Is se CH3-CH2-Br (bromoethane) banta hai.
blocks.caption: Electrophilic addition: ethene aur hydrogen bromide se bromoethane (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab yeh reaction aik qadam mein dikhati hai. Asal mein yeh do qadam mein hota hai: pehle C=C ka π jora H⁺ (electrophile) ko pakarta hai aur carbocation CH₃–CH₂⁺ banta hai, aur Br⁻ alag ho jata hai; phir Br⁻ carbocation se jur kar bromoethane banata hai.
iv) Elimination Reactions
Is reaction mein molecule ke do saath wale carbon atoms se do atoms ya groups hat jate hain, aur un ke hatne se double ya triple bond ban jata hai.

blocks.alt: Lone pair wala HO- aur bromoethane, CH2-CH2-Br ki shakal mein jis ke pehle carbon ke oopar H hai; Br se jura carbon +delta aur Br -delta. Teen mure teer: HO- ke lone pair se H ki taraf, C-H bond se C-C bond ki taraf, aur C-Br bond se Br ki taraf. Products: CH2=CH2 (ethene) + H2O + Br-.
blocks.caption: Elimination: hydroxide ion aur bromoethane se ethene, paani aur bromide ion (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka; kitab ki ghalati durust).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teen teer aik saath chalte hain: HO⁻ aik carbon se H kheench leta hai (paani banta hai), C–H bond ka jora dono carbons ke darmiyan doosra bond banata hai, aur Br apna jora le kar Br⁻ ban jata hai. Kitab Br wale CH₂ par “−δ” chhaapti hai; Br carbon se zyada electronegative hai, is liye us carbon par +δ hota hai, aur khaake mein +δ likha hai.
Quick Check 19.6

blocks.prompt: a) Electrophile, nucleophile ya free radical batayein: i) NH₃ ii) Br iii) H₂O iv) NO₂⁺ v) Clδ⁺
blocks.explanation: i) NH₃: nucleophile (N par lone pair). ii) Br (akela bromine atom, Br•): free radical. iii) H₂O: nucleophile (O par lone pairs). iv) NO₂⁺: electrophile. v) Clδ⁺: electrophile.

blocks.prompt: b) Addition, substitution, elimination ya rearrangement batayein: (i) CH₃CH=CH₂ + HBr → CH₃CHBrCH₃ (ii) CH₄ + Br₂ → CH₃Br + HBr (iii) CH₃CH₂CHClCH₃ → CH₃CH₂CH=CH₂ + HCl
c) Substitution, addition, hydrolysis, reduction, condensation ya oxidation batayein: (i) (CH₃)₂C=O + H₂N–NH₂ → (CH₃)₂C=N–NH₂ + H₂O (ii) CH₃CHO + 2[H] → CH₃CH₂OH
blocks.explanation: (i) condensation: do molecules jur kar paani nikalte hain. (ii) reduction: hydrogen milta hai; yeh C=O par H₂ ka addition bhi hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Free radical mechanism: homolysis; initiation → propagation → termination (maslan methane ki chlorination).
Ionic mechanism: heterolysis; nucleophilic substitution, nucleophilic addition, electrophilic addition, elimination.
Curly arrows electron jore ki harkat dikhate hain.
